incidents_catalogued.location: experiments/EXP-07/ historical reports (C15 line 147, C16, C17, C18, C19 narrative tables)
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: C8 and C10 historical baselines achieved ~0.4072 (40.7%) DEV phenomena mIoU, framing C16 (0.0494) as an ~88% catastrophic collapse.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Direct forensic audit of Level 5 machine artifacts (checkpoints, training results, and logs in data/metadata/exp07_p0_c8_training_results_seed42_v1.json and data/metadata/exp07_p0_c10_training_results_seed101_v1.json) proves C8 best DEV phenomena mIoU was 0.119031 (11.90%) and C10 was 0.137819 (13.78%). The claimed 0.4072 was a narrative transcription error introduced in C15.
incidents_catalogued.impact: Distorted four generations of retrospective reporting by misrepresenting the baseline gap as an 8.2x collapse instead of the actual ~2.4x-2.8x domain performance delta.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Unverified narrative transcription of an all-class or background-inclusive metric into a phenomena-only column in C15 markdown report without cross-checking machine JSON artifacts.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Established exact Level 5 machine truth in C20 audit artifacts (ops02_c20_checkpoint_lineage_audit_v1.json and ops02_c20_cross_eval_results_v1.json). Preserved all historical reports intact while establishing definitive machine authority. Formulated GOV-RULE-100.

incidents_catalogued.location: C16 run records (OPS02_v1.0.0_FROZEN) vs C19 protocol reconciliation table (OPS02_v1.0.1_FROZEN)
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: C19 protocol table referenced OPS02_v1.0.1_FROZEN as canonical post-freeze dataset identity, creating ambiguity whether C16 trained on an unpatched or obsolete dataset.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: SHA256 hashes of physical tiles, ground-truth masks, spatial dimensions (256x256), and partition assignments (132 TRAIN, 40 DEV, 40 HOLDOUT) are 100% bitwise identical between v1.0.0 and v1.0.1. The difference was exclusively a documentation text correction fixing a narrative transcription error (41/39 to 40/40 DEV/HOLDOUT).
incidents_catalogued.impact: Risk of epistemic confusion regarding physical data provenance.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Specification version increment applied to documentation without explicitly annotating that physical bytes remained immutable.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Documented in ops02_c20_dataset_firewall_v1.json and lineage audit that C16 physically consumed the exact bitwise dataset defined in v1.0.1. Historical records left unchanged.

incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Assumed homogeneous serialization structure across all historical EXP-07 checkpoints.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: C8 and C10 checkpoints (171.9 MB each) encapsulate full training state dictionaries ('model_state_dict', 'optimizer_state_dict', 'scheduler_state_dict', 'epoch', 'best_dev_metric'), whereas C16 checkpoint (57.4 MB) contains only the model's OrderedDict state_dict.
incidents_catalogued.impact: Direct state_dict deserialization crashed without a conditional container unwrapper.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Evolution of training checkpoint export routines between C8/C10 and C16.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Implemented dual-format polymorphic loading in scripts/run_exp07_c20_cross_evaluation.py without altering raw checkpoint bytes.
